about: The Workbench icons of the SDLPoP drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py icons/icons.json --out icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is SDLPoP's own program icon (upstream src/icon.ico at the pinned commit, its 32x32 picture; the same as data/icon.png, the window icon), GPL-3.0-or-later with the engine.
